shared_elements: incised linear motifs cut into stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow incised abstract linear motifs, including angular and curved strokes, but A shows only a small scatter of isolated chevron-like marks with no evident organisation, while B shows a coherent programme of concentric rings, spirals, a broad curving band across the back and a hooked motif, all deployed on the back of a large anthropomorphic figure with a head and shoulders. The presence of a sculpted human form and a structured symmetrical composition in B has no counterpart in A, so only the most generic 'incised lines on stone' correspondence remains.
